listLauncherProviders.description: Public safe projection of approved, active providers only. Cookies never select the account; Authorization and query parameters are rejected. startLauncherGameLogin.description: Call after manual provider selection and game profile selection. The S256 verifier is base64url of 32 random bytes, held in Launcher memory. Attempts expire after 120 seconds. JSON POST only; Cookie identity, Authorization and arbitrary authentication URLs are not accepted.

exchangeLauncherGameLogin.summary: Verify a game identity and issue a Launcher token
exchangeLauncherGameLogin.description: One-use nonce/verifier checks, online validation against a fixed provider, and account UID/profile ownership verification. gameProfile is an untrusted claim, not a credential; verified CODE:UID identifies the local account. Only approved MUA Yggdrasil Connect adapters are supported; other providers use browser login. Read-only tokens last at most 900 seconds and expire 30 seconds before the upstream token. No refresh token or browser Cookie. Body limit 32768 bytes; game token limit 16384 characters; extra fields, query parameters and Authorization are rejected. Redact credentials and disable caching. Start a new attempt after a used attempt or lost response. Upstream revocation may take the remaining 15-minute lifetime to propagate.

saveLauncherProvider.summary: Approve or disable a Launcher authentication provider

Confirm actual OAuth UID equivalence and upstream credential-log redaction; record version and verification evidence. Saving increments revision and invalidates old provider sessions. Directory changes require reapproval.

listClients.summary: List accessible clients and package progress
listClients.description: Returns only clients readable under current RBAC; deleted records are hidden. Drafts/uploads require DRAFT_READ; releases require RELEASE_READ. Poll drafts[].packageBuilds and releases[].packageBuilds for build progress: there is no separate build-status endpoint. ARCHIVED takes precedence. Upload canEdit indicates ownership or superadmin access.

createClient.description:
Names are unique within an organization after NFKC normalization and case folding; use update for existing names. Organization sessions may create unbound clients; Bearer tokens must choose an authorized server. Choosing a server additionally requires CLIENT_BIND and confirmed server publicationRevision, expectedClientId and replaceConfirmed when replacing a binding. Client IDs are UUIDs.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

getClient.summary: Get client details and actual task progress
getClient.description: Read the client publicationRevision, current release, server bindingRevision, draft contentRevision/packageRevision, uploads and packageBuilds. Permission-filtered history arrays may be empty. Cross-scope access returns 404 or 403. These revision types are not interchangeable.

createClientUpload.description:
Upload a full .zip/.mrpack, not a delta ZIP. Pin client baseReleaseId and basePublicationRevision; updates additionally require DRAFT_EDIT. comparisonDraftId compares/replaces an unpublished draft and needs DRAFT_ARCHIVE. Format is immutable and defaults to 1. Disabled formats return 409, the current upload limit returns 413, and 20 active uploads return 429. Parts are 64 MiB; sessions expire after 24 hours.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

signUploadPart.description:
Requires an unexpired UPLOADING task and a partNumber within its part count. PUT binary bytes directly to the returned storage URL and save the original ETag; this is not backend multipart/form-data. Nonfinal parts use partSize; the last may be smaller. Browser storage CORS must expose ETag. Only the upload owner or superadmin may write; updates also require DRAFT_EDIT.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

The URL signs the exact Content-Length computed from the saved upload size and part number, including the final part. Send exactly those bytes using a Blob or a known-length buffer; browsers set Content-Length automatically. Missing or altered lengths fail storage authentication before completion. Huawei uses V4 for these upload URLs.

completeClientUpload.summary: Complete multipart upload and queue import
completeClientUpload.description:
Submit all part numbers and original ETags. Storage validates parts and total size before assembly; assembly runs outside the database lock, then identity and scope are checked again. Repeated completion retains the existing state. QUEUED means awaiting import, not imported, built or published.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

getClientUpload.summary: Read import progress and instance candidates
getClientUpload.description: Poll status, processingPhase, detectedInfo, detectedMods, warnings and progress. SELECT_INSTANCE requires an explicit choice from candidates. Upload READY means import completion only. v2 remote files remain DECLARED and Launcher prepares their bytes and environments. statistics/recipeStatistics describe the published player base; comparisonStatistics describes an unpublished draft comparison.

selectClientInstance.summary: Select a target instance from the source pack
selectClientInstance.description:
Only QUEUED with processingPhase=SELECT_INSTANCE is accepted. instanceId must match a detected candidate. Resumes Worker processing and rechecks the pinned publication base without reuploading bytes.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

submitClientUpload.summary: Submit an imported version for review
submitClientUpload.description:
Requires READY import and DRAFT_SUBMIT. The request must not contain mods or modDetails; Worker results supply them. Minecraft and Java may use detected metadata. v1 may select platforms, defaulting to five; v2 rejects platforms. Version ordering, name confirmation, immutable content and idempotent retries remain enforced.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

retryClientUpload.description:
Only FAILED tasks may be retried. Clears progress, errors and leases and queues the saved source bytes again; no source reupload is needed.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

cancelClientUpload.description:
Only UPLOADING, WAITING_PROCESSOR, QUEUED, READY or FAILED may be cancelled. PROCESSING and submitted tasks cannot be cancelled this way. Business history is preserved.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

getDraftManifest.description: Requires DRAFT_READ and verifies the candidate digest. v1 returns the legacy client manifest; v2 constructs the recipe target from draft content. The response is reserialized JSON and is not the original signed bytes of a published manifest.

getDraftPlatformManifest.summary: Read a prepared platform or recipe manifest
getDraftPlatformManifest.description: v1 requires a canonical platform. v2 uses a universal task; new platform-independent drafts ignore platform inputs while historical declarations are checked. Unprepared manifests return 404; corrupt or changed plans return 422.

reviewClientDraft.summary: Approve or reject a submitted draft
reviewClientDraft.description:
Requires DRAFT_REVIEW and SUBMITTED state. contentRevision and packageRevision are required and must match the current draft. Rejections require a nonempty note. Approval queues signed package generation; it does not publish the release.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

configureDraftPlatforms.description:
Only unarchived v1 SUBMITTED/APPROVED drafts. Requires DRAFT_CREATE and DRAFT_SUBMIT; updates also need DRAFT_EDIT. v2 returns 409. A changed selection increments packageRevision, clears review and returns to SUBMITTED for review again. An unchanged selection returns ok.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

retryDraftPackages.description:
Only unarchived SUBMITTED/APPROVED drafts; updates also require DRAFT_EDIT. Requeues failed required builds. Poll client details; every required task must be READY before publication.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

publishClientDraft.summary: Publish an approved and fully built version
publishClientDraft.description:
Requires APPROVED with matching reviewed revisions and verified READY artifacts. activate=true also requires RELEASE_ACTIVATE. Changing replacesDraftId requires DRAFT_ARCHIVE and both current draft revisions. Only successful publication archives the explicit replacement chain. Published content is immutable. First responses include activated/archivedDraftIds; retries return only releaseId/versionLabel.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

activateClientRelease.summary: Activate or roll back to an existing release
activateClientRelease.description:
publicationRevision is the client revision, not the server binding revision; read it from current client details. Only this client''s unarchived releases may be activated. Pending replacement also checks CLIENT_BIND and the confirmed server binding; conflicts return 409.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

archiveClientDraft.description:
Requires DRAFT_ARCHIVE and both draft revisions. Published releases cannot be withdrawn through this operation. Invalidates active build leases while retaining READY artifacts and references. Repeated archival returns ok; there is no restore parameter here.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

downloadDraftPackage.description: Requires DRAFT_READ. Always returns full with a 300-second link, regardless of public server listing. v1 requires a canonical platform. New v2 ignores platform inputs, but management responses still include platform=universal. Not READY returns 409; storage size/digest failures return 422.

downloadReleasePackage.description: Requires RELEASE_READ and current client scope. Always returns full with a 300-second link, regardless of public server listing. v1 requires a canonical platform. New v2 ignores platform inputs, but management responses still include platform=universal. Not READY returns 409; storage size/digest failures return 422.

bindClient.summary: Bind a server in the same organization
bindClient.description:
Checks the client, target server and any replaced client with CLIENT_BIND. publicationRevision is the server binding revision; expectedClientId must match, and replacements need replaceConfirmed. A client binds at most one server. An unpublished replacement may return pending=true, retaining the old client until reviewed publication and activation completes the confirmed replacement.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

unbindClient.summary: Unbind a client or cancel a pending binding
unbindClient.description:
serverId/publicationRevision must match the current binding; both are null when unbound. Archived clients may also be unbound. Keeps the current release, history, storage and fixed scopeServerId. Does not automatically restore distribution.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

archiveClient.description:
Requires CLIENT_ARCHIVE. Archival stops distribution and clears actual/pending bindings without removing immutable releases or moving storage objects. Restoration does not automatically list or bind the client. ARCHIVED overrides published lifecycle status.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

deleteClient.description:
Requires CLIENT_DELETE, archival, no actual/pending binding and no PROCESSING upload/build. Published history does not prevent deletion. Retains irreversible deletion markers, signed history and audit, hides the client and releases its name. Cancels pending uploads; Worker recycles files with shared CAS reference protection.

Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use '{}' for actions that ignore the parsed body.

getAdminState.description: Every active panel session may read. Organizations, servers and members are filtered by current RBAC. Account directory, events and complete-window audit counts are superadmin-only and otherwise empty. Ordinary accounts read enabledPackageFormats/maxUploadSizeMb here.

getPipeline.summary: Read storage, Worker and signing status
getPipeline.description: Superadmin panel sessions only. Reports actual bucket connectivity, nullable public signing identity, queues and Worker heartbeats from the last 30 seconds. No private keys or storage credentials are returned.

getStorageTelemetry.description: Superadmin Cookie sessions only. Reads platform-wide Worker-collected capacity and observed traffic for today in Asia/Shanghai, independent of organization filters. Bytes and object counts are decimal strings; missing values are null. Traffic includes Worker and admin access, not complete player downloads or billing. Gaps and intervals crossing midnight are not estimated. CDN remains NOT_CONNECTED.

searchOrganizationAccounts.description: Requires organization ORG_MEMBERS_READ. q needs at least three trimmed characters and at most 64 original characters. Searches ACTIVE accounts by username/display name, case-insensitively, returning up to ten sorted by display name.

listApiTokens.description: Panel Cookie only. Returns this account''s tokens, including revoked records, without plaintext. Bearer tokens cannot authenticate this administration endpoint.

createApiToken.description:
Panel Cookie only. All serverIds/permissions must be within current account authority. SERVER_READ is mandatory; ORG_* and SERVER_EDIT are forbidden. Valid for 1-90 days. Plaintext appears only in this creation response. Effective authority intersects current account RBAC; disabling accounts, removing grants or revoking tokens takes effect immediately.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

revokeApiToken.description:
Only tokens belonging to the current account may be revoked. Records remain; subsequent Bearer calls return 401.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

createOrganization.description:
Superadmin only. Creates an internal UUID. The display alias and description may later be edited; avatars use the dedicated upload endpoint.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

updateOrganization.description:
Requires organization ORG_EDIT. Only the listed detail fields may change; the internal ID is immutable. Editing or clearing a description permanently stops automatic skin-site name synchronization. Omitting or saving an unchanged description preserves its synchronization mode.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

createServer.summary: Register an existing MUA server ID
createServer.description:
Superadmin only with ORG_EDIT. Register an existing 3–5 letter MUA ID. Choose displayMode PERMANENT or RANGE during registration; omission defaults to permanent. Range requires timezone-qualified start and end timestamps with start before end. Permanent timestamps must be null or omitted. Managed server-mottos/ keys must be set through the image endpoint.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

updateServer.summary: Edit server details and display settings
updateServer.description:
Scoped SERVER_EDIT allows profile, color and permanent/range display settings. Sort order and listing still require a superadmin panel session. A range needs valid timezone-qualified start and end with start before end; changing to PERMANENT clears the range. Display settings affect directory visibility only, not client activation, binding or download. Managed server-mottos/ references must use the image endpoint.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

archiveOrganization.description:

archiveServer.description:
Superadmin only, with server scope validation. Keeps history while stopping distribution and clearing binding. Restoration does not automatically relist or rebind.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

setOrganizationMember.summary: Set membership status and organization roles
setOrganizationMember.description:
Requires ORG_MEMBERS_MANAGE. Disabled accounts cannot be newly added. Ordinary administrators cannot alter superadmins or members with reserved roles. ORG_ADMIN/REVIEWER/PUBLISHER/RELEASE_OPERATOR grants and revocations require superadmin. Disabled membership records remain.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

setServerGrant.description:
Requires ORG_MEMBERS_MANAGE and SERVER_READ. The account must already belong to this organization, and the server must be in it. ORG_ADMIN cannot be a single-server grant. Empty roles revoke access while retaining records. Reserved roles still require superadmin.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

createAccount.description:
Superadmin only. Usernames are trimmed and lowercased, 3-64 letters/digits or underscore, dot and hyphen. Initial passwords need 12-128 characters. Do not embed real passwords in documentation examples or persisted test settings.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

updateAccount.summary: Change account status, platform role or password
updateAccount.description:
Superadmin only. Retain at least one ACTIVE superadmin. Disabling, changing the superadmin flag or resetting a password revokes account sessions. Username is not an allowed update field.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

getRecycleSettings.description: Dedicated GET/PATCH endpoints require a superadmin panel session. Retention is 1-365 integer days, default 7. Shortening it causes expired files to be removed on the next Worker cleanup; shared references remain protected.

setRecycleSettings.description:
Superadmin only, audited. Retention is 1-365 integer days, default 7. Expired recycled files may be permanently removed during the next cleanup; shared references remain protected.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

getUploadSizeSettings.description: Dedicated GET/PATCH endpoints require superadmin. Ordinary panel accounts read the limit through /api/admin/state. Range 1-20480 integer MB, default 1024; one MB is 1024 squared bytes. Only new source uploads are limited.

setUploadSizeSettings.description:
Superadmin only, audited. Range 1-20480 integer MB; one MB is 1024 squared bytes. Affects new uploads only, without cancelling existing tasks or limiting generated artifacts.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

getPackageFormatSettings.description: Superadmin-only dedicated GET/PATCH. Ordinary panel accounts read enabled formats through /api/admin/state. Defaults to [1,2], with at least one distinct format enabled.

setPackageFormatSettings.description:
Superadmin only, audited. At least one distinct format must remain enabled. Disabling prevents new uploads but does not cancel existing tasks or delist historical releases.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

getDownloadSettings.summary: Read Worker source and proxy settings
getDownloadSettings.description: Superadmin panel session only. Returns current host allowlist, proxy, mirror preferences and Java image type.

setDownloadSettings.summary: Change Worker source and proxy settings
setDownloadSettings.description:
Superadmin only, audited. Older callers may omit mirror fields to preserve current values. An enabled proxy needs a credential-free HTTP(S) host/port URL. Disabling the host allowlist retains HTTPS/public-IP/DNS-pinning/redirect/hash safeguards. Mirror proxying also needs the global proxy; MinIO bypasses it. JRE is default; only superadmins may choose JDK.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

probeServer.description: Requires SERVER_READ before and after probing. Uses the saved address only, with public DNS pinning, SRV, timeout, cache and concurrency safeguards. ONLINE confirms MC and low latency; HIGH_LATENCY defaults to at least 300 ms. Missing configuration, archival or service errors produce UNKNOWN.

getServerMotto.summary: Read the server image, source or crop metadata
getServerMotto.description: Requires SERVER_READ. variant=image/source returns binary image/webp; metadata returns JSON. Optional version is the current image directory UUID; changes return 409. Retained sources are normalized WebP and may be cropped again. Private reads use private, no-store cache control.

uploadServerMotto.summary: Upload or recrop the server motto image
uploadServerMotto.description:
Requires SERVER_EDIT. multipart/form-data crop and expectedIconObjectKey are JSON-encoded text, not nested form objects; an empty key is the text null. Omit source to recrop the retained source. New source supports static PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most 8 MiB and 16 million pixels; required crop ratio 2.35:1. Rechecks crop, identity, session, scope and revision after storage.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

removeServerMotto.summary: Remove the current motto image binding
removeServerMotto.description:
Requires SERVER_EDIT and an expectedIconObjectKey matching the current key; conflicts return 409. Retains old storage image objects and does not modify publication signatures.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

login.summary: Sign in with an allowlisted account
login.description:
Same-origin Origin is required; an old Cookie is optional. Returns ok and sets mua_session with HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Secure on HTTPS, and 12-hour expiry. Invalid credentials/disabled accounts return 401; throttling returns 429.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

Quotas are isolated by trusted proxy client address or, without AUTH_CLIENT_IP_HEADER, a resettable HttpOnly mua_login_client cookie (Path=/api/auth, SameSite=Lax, one day). The cookie is not a login credential. One client has 60 attempts per five minutes and 10 per username per 15 minutes. Password verification has bounded process concurrency; no shared whole-site attempt quota is used. Invalid trusted address headers return 400; invalid server header configuration returns 503. Production deployments without a trusted IP header need edge rate limiting.

logout.description:
Same-origin Origin is required; Cookie is optional. Removes the current session and clears mua_session with Max-Age=0. Send an empty JSON object.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.

changePassword.description:
Requires an active Cookie session and same-origin Origin. Validates the current password and a 12-128-character replacement. Revokes all account sessions and clears Cookie, requiring login again. Does not rewrite API token plaintext or permissions.

Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.
